1	# WellStream Platform — Integrated Energy Data Management
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	WellStream delivers integrated SaaS solutions for energy operators to manage well data, production, and land assets—streamlining operations and enhancing decision-making. From drilling to decommissioning, WellStream transforms every phase of energy operations with seamless, end-to-end data integration.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #15295A (primary navy), #6CC24A (accent green), #3C424B (dark gray)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: GET REAL-TIME DATA ACROSS YOUR ENTIRE OPERATION
    10	Subtitle: The integrated energy data platform built for operators who demand speed, security, and visibility across the well data lifecycle.
    11	CTA: "Explore the Platform" | "Request A Demo"
    12	
    13	## Featured Product Banner
    14	Product: WellStream Innova
    15	Tagline: Real-Time Drilling
    16	CTA: "Learn More"
    17	
    18	## Use Cases
    19	Label: USE CASES
    20	Heading: See the WellStream Platform in Action
    21	Description: From drilling to production, land to water, watch how WellStream transforms every phase of your operations. Streamline workflows, unlock real-time insights, and make every decision count with seamless, end-to-end data integration. Get it all—effortlessly.
    22	
    23	- **Drilling & Completions Management** — Centralize drilling programs, daily reports, and well design data in one accessible hub.
    24	- **Production Operations Oversight** — Monitor production volumes, allocations, and decline curves with real-time dashboards.
    25	- **Asset Integrity Monitoring** — Track well integrity risks, inspection schedules, and compliance status across your portfolio.
    26	- **Hydraulic Frac Data Centralization** — Consolidate frac stage data, chemical usage, and pressure readings for every completion.
    27	- **Facility Construction & Commissioning** — Manage site activity, construction milestones, and commissioning workflows digitally.
    28	- **Geospatial Asset Analysis** — Visualize well locations, land positions, and infrastructure on interactive map layers.
    29	
    30	CTA: "More Use Cases"
    31	
    32	## Platform Overview Diagram
    33	Three interconnected pillars of the WellStream Platform:
    34	- **Well Data Lifecycle** — Plan, drill, complete, and manage wells from spud to abandonment.
    35	- **Production Data Lifecycle** — Capture, allocate, report, and optimize production volumes.
    36	- **Land Data Management** — Track leases, agreements, obligations, and mineral rights.
    37	
    38	## Platform Benefits
    39	- **Save Time** — Eliminate manual data entry and redundant workflows with automated data capture and centralized reporting.
    40	- **Save Resources** — Reduce headcount dedicated to spreadsheet management by consolidating tools into one platform.
    41	- **Save Money** — Lower total cost of ownership versus maintaining multiple legacy systems and on-premise servers.
    42	- **Stay Connected** — Access your data from any device, anywhere, with cloud-native mobile and desktop applications.
    43	- **Stay Secure** — Enterprise-grade security with SOC compliance, SSO, and continuous monitoring protects your critical data.
    44	
    45	## Platform Statistics
    46	- **80** companies trust WellStream to manage their energy data
    47	- **89%** of clients are actively pursuing digital transformation initiatives
    48	- **31%** reported significant return on investment within the first year
    49	
    50	## Implementation Timeline
    51	- **3 WEEKS** — Independent Operator, from the demo to launch
    52	- **5 MONTHS** — Major Operator with extensive data log
    53	- **12 MONTHS** — Super Major International Operator
    54	
    55	## Accordion Features
    56	- **Get Speed** — Deploy in weeks, not years. Cloud-native architecture means zero hardware and instant scalability.
    57	- **Get Secure** — SOC 1 & 2 certified, Azure-powered infrastructure with 24/7 monitoring and encryption at rest and in transit.
    58	- **Get Mobility** — Field-ready mobile apps that sync in real time, even in low-connectivity environments.
    59	- **Get Real-Time Reporting** — Configurable dashboards deliver live KPIs to executives, engineers, and field teams simultaneously.
    60	- **Get Connected** — Open APIs, ETL pipelines, and pre-built connectors integrate WellStream with your existing tech stack.
    61	
    62	## Security Features
    63	- **SOC 1 & 2 Certified Compliance** — Annual third-party audits verify controls over financial and operational data handling.
    64	- **Powered by Microsoft Azure** — Enterprise cloud infrastructure with geo-redundant data centers and 99.95% uptime SLA.
    65	- **Performance Monitoring** — Continuous application and infrastructure monitoring with automated alerting and incident response.
    66	- **Single Sign-On (SSO) Authentication** — Integrate with your corporate identity provider for seamless, secure access management.
    67	- **Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) System** — Real-time log aggregation, threat detection, and forensic analysis across all platform components.
    68	
    69	## ETL Key Benefits
    70	- **Read-Only Snowflake Access** — Query your WellStream data directly in Snowflake without impacting production performance.
    71	- **Supports BI Warehousing** — Feed Power BI, Tableau, or Spotfire with clean, structured energy data pipelines.
    72	- **Handles Complex Use Cases** — Map multi-source data from SCADA, accounting, and regulatory systems into unified schemas.
    73	- **Improves System Interoperability** — Bridge legacy databases and modern cloud applications with managed ETL orchestration.
    74	
    75	## Integration Tabs
    76	- **ETL** — Automated extract-transform-load pipelines move data between WellStream and enterprise systems on schedule.
    77	- **APIs** — RESTful APIs enable real-time programmatic access for custom applications and third-party integrations.
    78	- **Dashboards** — Pre-built and configurable visualization layers surface insights without requiring data exports.
    79	
    80	## Company Culture
    81	Heading: WellStream: Fearless Innovation
    82	Description: At WellStream, innovation drives everything we do. From a two-person startup to a global leader, we've built a culture of collaboration and bold ideas. Join a team that empowers 600+ clients worldwide with cutting-edge solutions in well, production, and land data management. With mobility, automation, and data integration at our core, we're shaping the future of energy together.
    83	CTA: "Find Out More"
    84	
    85	## Renewables CTA
    86	Heading: WellStream Renewables
    87	Description: Unlock peak efficiency with WellStream Land. Our tools, LandView and LandView Map, supercharge solar, wind, utilities, geothermal, and carbon capture projects. Drive energy innovation and transform your operations now.
    88	CTA: "Find Out More"
    89	
    90	## Testimonials
    91	- "WellStream cut our reporting cycle from days to minutes. We finally have one source of truth." — VP Operations, Mid-Continent E&P
    92	- "Implementation was seamless. The team had us live in under four weeks." — Data Manager, Permian Basin Operator
    93	- "The mobile app changed how our field teams capture data—no more paper tickets." — Completions Engineer, Rockies Operator
    94	
    95	## Demo Form
    96	Heading: REQUEST A DEMO
    97	Description: Experience WellStream's integrated energy data platform firsthand. Schedule a personalized demo to see how our solutions can optimize your operations and increase profitability.
    98	Fields: First Name, Last Name, Business Email, Company, Phone Number, Job Title, Country, Comments
    99	CTA: "Submit"
   100	
   101	## Support Contact
   102	Global support available across North America, Latin America, and Middle East/North Africa regions. Contact our team for technical assistance, implementation questions, or partnership inquiries.
   103	
   104	## Well Data Lifecycle Products
   105	| Product | Function |
   106	|---------|----------|
   107	| WellView Allez | Well Data Management |
   108	| RigView | Rig Scheduling |
   109	| Well Reliability | Downtime Analysis |
   110	| Well Integrity | Risk Monitoring |
   111	| WellStream Frac | Frac Stage Tracking |
   112	| SiteView Allez | Site Activity Overview |
   113	| SiteView Go | Mobile Site Data |
   114	| WellStream Ram | Flow Optimization Model |
   115	| WellStream Innova | Real-time Directional Data Exchange |
   116	| WellStream Equipment | Equipment Tracking |
   117	| WellStream Water | Water Use Tracking |
   118	| WellStream Water Go | Mobile Water Management |
   119	| WellStream Dashboards | Clear Actionable Views |
   120	
   121	## Industry Tabs
   122	Tab labels: E&P · Midstream · Downstream · Utilities · Solar/Wind · Mining
   123	
   124	## Footer Navigation
   125	Platform: Platform Overview · Security · Integration · Services + Support
   126	Solutions: By Industry · By Use Case
   127	Company: About Us · Careers · Contact
   128	Legal: Cookie Settings · Exercise Your Rights
   129	Login portals: WellStream Platform · WellStream Frac · Locksmith

     2	name: frontend-design-ultimate
     3	description: Create distinctive, production-grade static sites with React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui — no mockups needed. Generates bold, memorable designs from plain text requirements with anti-AI-slop aesthetics, mobile-first responsive patterns, and single-file bundling. Use when building landing pages, marketing sites, portfolios, dashboards, or any static web UI. Supports both Vite (pure static) and Next.js (Vercel deploy) workflows.
     4	homepage: https://github.com/kesslerio/frontend-design-ultimate-clawhub-skill
     5	metadata:
     6	  openclaw:
     7	    emoji: "🎨"
     8	    requires:
     9	      bins: ["node", "npm"]
    10	
    11	---
    12	
    13	# Frontend Design Ultimate
    14	
    15	Create distinctive, production-grade static sites from text requirements alone. No mockups, no Figma — just describe what you want and get bold, memorable designs.
    16	
    17	**Stack**: React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Framer Motion  
    18	**Output**: Vite (static HTML) or Next.js (Vercel-ready)
    19	
    20	## Quick Start
    21	
    22	```
    23	"Build a SaaS landing page for an AI writing tool. Dark theme, 
    24	editorial typography, subtle grain texture. Pages: hero with 
    25	animated demo, features grid, pricing table, FAQ accordion, footer."
    26	```
    27	
    28	---
    29	
    30	## Design Thinking (Do This First)
    31	
    32	Before writing any code, commit to a **BOLD aesthetic direction**:
    33	
    34	### 1. Understand Context
    35	
    36	- **Purpose**: What problem does this interface solve? Who uses it?
    37	- **Audience**: Developer tools? Consumer app? Enterprise? Creative agency?
    38	- **Constraints**: Performance requirements, accessibility needs, brand guidelines?
    39	
    40	### 2. Choose an Extreme Tone
    41	
    42	Pick ONE and commit fully — timid designs fail:
    43	
    44	| Tone                       | Characteristics                                           |
    45	| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
    46	| **Brutally Minimal**       | Sparse, monochrome, massive typography, raw edges         |
    47	| **Maximalist Chaos**       | Layered, dense, overlapping elements, controlled disorder |
    48	| **Retro-Futuristic**       | Neon accents, geometric shapes, CRT aesthetics            |
    49	| **Organic/Natural**        | Soft curves, earth tones, hand-drawn elements             |
    50	| **Luxury/Refined**         | Subtle animations, premium typography, restrained palette |
    51	| **Editorial/Magazine**     | Strong grid, dramatic headlines, whitespace as feature    |
    52	| **Brutalist/Raw**          | Exposed structure, harsh contrasts, anti-design           |
    53	| **Art Deco/Geometric**     | Gold accents, symmetry, ornate patterns                   |
    54	| **Soft/Pastel**            | Rounded corners, gentle gradients, friendly               |
    55	| **Industrial/Utilitarian** | Functional, monospace, data-dense                         |
    56	
    57	### 3. Define the Unforgettable Element
    58	
    59	What's the ONE thing someone will remember? A hero animation? Typography treatment? Color combination? Unusual layout?
    60	
    61	---
    62	
    63	## Aesthetics Guidelines
    64	
    65	### Typography — NEVER Generic
    66	
    67	**BANNED**: Inter, Roboto, Arial, system fonts, Open Sans
    68	
    69	**DO**: Distinctive, characterful choices that elevate the design.
    70	
    71	| Use Case          | Approach                                                     |
    72	| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
    73	| Display/Headlines | Bold personality — Clash, Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, Space Grotesk (sparingly), Playfair Display |
    74	| Body Text         | Refined readability — Instrument Sans, General Sans, Plus Jakarta Sans |
    75	| Monospace/Code    | DM Mono, JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono                       |
    76	| Pairing Strategy  | Contrast weights (thin display + bold body), contrast styles (serif + geometric sans) |
    77	
    78	**Size Progression**: Use 3x+ jumps, not timid 1.5x increments.
    79	
    80	### Color & Theme
    81	
    82	**BANNED**: Purple gradients on white, evenly-distributed 5-color palettes
    83	
    84	**DO**:
    85	
    86	- **Dominant + Sharp Accent**: 70-20-10 rule (primary-secondary-accent)
    87	- **CSS Variables**: `--primary`, `--accent`, `--surface`, `--text`
    88	- **Commit to dark OR light**: Don't hedge with gray middle-grounds
    89	- **High contrast CTAs**: Buttons should pop dramatically
    90	
    91	```css
    92	:root {
    93	  --bg-primary: #0a0a0a;
    94	  --bg-secondary: #141414;
    95	  --text-primary: #fafafa;
    96	  --text-secondary: #a1a1a1;
    97	  --accent: #ff6b35;
    98	  --accent-hover: #ff8555;
    99	}
   100	```
   101	
   102	### Motion & Animation
   103	
   104	**Priority**: One orchestrated page load > scattered micro-interactions
   105	
   106	**High-Impact Moments**:
   107	
   108	- Staggered hero reveals (`animation-delay`)
   109	- Scroll-triggered section entrances
   110	- Hover states that surprise (scale, color shift, shadow depth)
   111	- Smooth page transitions
   112	
   113	**Implementation**:
   114	
   115	- CSS-only for simple animations
   116	- Framer Motion for React (pre-installed via init scripts)
   117	- Keep durations 200-400ms (snappy, not sluggish)
   118	
   119	### Spatial Composition
   120	
   121	**BANNED**: Centered, symmetrical, predictable layouts
   122	
   123	**DO**:
   124	
   125	- Asymmetry with purpose
   126	- Overlapping elements
   127	- Diagonal flow / grid-breaking
   128	- Generous negative space OR controlled density (pick one)
   129	- Off-grid hero sections
   130	
   131	### Backgrounds & Atmosphere
   132	
   133	**BANNED**: Solid white/gray backgrounds
   134	
   135	**DO**:
   136	
   137	- Gradient meshes (subtle, not garish)
   138	- Noise/grain textures (SVG filter or CSS)
   139	- Geometric patterns (dots, lines, shapes)
   140	- Layered transparencies
   141	- Dramatic shadows for depth
   142	- Blur effects for glassmorphism
   143	
   144	```css
   145	/* Subtle grain overlay */
   146	.grain::before {
   147	  content: '';
   148	  position: fixed;
   149	  inset: 0;
   150	  background: url("data:image/svg+xml,...") repeat;
   151	  opacity: 0.03;
   152	  pointer-events: none;
   153	}
   154	```
   155	
   156	---
   157	
   158	## Mobile-First Patterns
   159	
   160	See **[references/mobile-patterns.md](references/mobile-patterns.md)** for detailed CSS.
   161	
   162	### Critical Rules
   163	
   164	| Pattern                 | Desktop           | Mobile Fix                                   |
   165	| ----------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
   166	| Hero with hidden visual | 2-column grid     | Switch to `display: flex` (not grid)         |
   167	| Large selection lists   | Horizontal scroll | Accordion with category headers              |
   168	| Multi-column forms      | Side-by-side      | Stack vertically                             |
   169	| Status/alert cards      | Inline            | `align-items: center` + `text-align: center` |
   170	| Feature grids           | 3-4 columns       | Single column                                |
   171	
   172	### Breakpoints
   173	
   174	```css
   175	/* Tablet - stack sidebars */
   176	@media (max-width: 1200px) { }
   177	
   178	/* Mobile - full single column */
   179	@media (max-width: 768px) { }
   180	
   181	/* Small mobile - compact spacing */
   182	@media (max-width: 480px) { }
   183	```
   184	
   185	### Font Scaling
   186	
   187	```css
   188	@media (max-width: 768px) {
   189	  .hero-title { font-size: 32px; }      /* from ~48px */
   190	  .section-title { font-size: 24px; }   /* from ~32px */
   191	  .section-subtitle { font-size: 14px; } /* from ~16px */
   192	}
   193	```
   194	
   195	---
   196	
   197	## Build Workflow
   198	
   199	### Option A: Vite (Pure Static) — Recommended (Offline)
   200	
   201	A pre-built Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui template with all dependencies is available at `/app/templates/vite-react`. Use it directly without network access:
   202	
   203	```bash
   204	# 1. Copy the pre-installed template
   205	cp -r /app/templates/vite-react my-site
   206	cd my-site
   207	
   208	# 2. Develop — edit src/App.tsx, add components in src/components/
   209	# All shadcn/ui components (button, badge, card, accordion, dialog,
   210	# navigation-menu, tabs, sheet, separator, avatar, alert) are pre-installed.
   211	# Framer Motion, Lucide icons, and Tailwind CSS are ready to use.
   212	
   213	# 3. Build static files
   214	npm run build
   215	# Output: dist/
   216	
   217	# 4. Bundle to single HTML (optional)
   218	bash /app/skills/scripts/bundle-artifact.sh
   219	# Output: bundle.html
   220	```
   221	
   222	### Option B: Init from Scratch (Requires Internet)
   223	
   224	If internet access is available, you can scaffold from scratch:
   225	
   226	```bash
   227	# Vite
   228	bash /app/skills/scripts/init-vite.sh my-site
   229	
   230	# Next.js
   231	bash /app/skills/scripts/init-nextjs.sh my-site
   232	```
   233	
   234	---
   235	
   236	## Project Structure
   237	
   238	### Vite Static (Pre-installed Template)
   239	
   240	```
   241	my-site/                      # copied from /app/templates/vite-react
   242	├── src/
   243	│   ├── components/
   244	│   │   └── ui/              # Pre-installed shadcn/ui components
   245	│   ├── lib/
   246	│   │   └── utils.ts         # cn() helper for className merging
   247	│   ├── styles/              # Global CSS
   248	│   ├── config/
   249	│   │   └── site.ts          # Editable content config
   250	│   ├── App.tsx
   251	│   └── main.tsx
   252	├── index.html
   253	├── components.json           # shadcn/ui config — required for adding components
   254	├── tailwind.config.ts
   255	├── vite.config.ts            # Path aliases (@/) configured
   256	├── tsconfig.json
   257	└── package.json
   258	```
   259	
   260	**`components.json`** is the shadcn/ui configuration file. It tells the `npx shadcn@latest add` CLI where to place components, which aliases to use, and the Tailwind CSS config path. It is pre-configured with:
   261	- Style: `default`
   262	- TSX: enabled, RSC: disabled (Vite, not Next.js)
   263	- Aliases: `@/components`, `@/components/ui`, `@/lib`
   264	
   265	### Next.js
   266	
   267	```
   268	my-site/
   269	├── app/
   270	│   ├── layout.tsx
   271	│   ├── page.tsx
   272	│   └── privacy/page.tsx
   273	├── components/
   274	├── lib/
   275	├── config/
   276	│   └── site.ts
   277	└── tailwind.config.ts
   278	```
   279	
   280	---
   281	
   282	## Site Config Pattern
   283	
   284	Keep all editable content in one file:
   285	
   286	```typescript
   287	// config/site.ts
   288	export const siteConfig = {
   289	  name: "Acme AI",
   290	  tagline: "Write better, faster",
   291	  description: "AI-powered writing assistant",
   292	  
   293	  hero: {
   294	    badge: "Now in beta",
   295	    title: "Your words,\nsupercharged",
   296	    subtitle: "Write 10x faster with AI that understands your style",
   297	    cta: { text: "Get Started", href: "/signup" },
   298	    secondaryCta: { text: "Watch Demo", href: "#demo" },
   299	  },
   300	  
   301	  features: [
   302	    { icon: "Zap", title: "Lightning Fast", description: "..." },
   303	    // ...
   304	  ],
   305	  
   306	  pricing: [
   307	    { name: "Free", price: 0, features: [...] },
   308	    { name: "Pro", price: 19, features: [...], popular: true },
   309	  ],
   310	  
   311	  faq: [
   312	    { q: "How does it work?", a: "..." },
   313	  ],
   314	  
   315	  footer: {
   316	    links: [...],
   317	    social: [...],
   318	  }
   319	}
   320	```
   321	
   322	---
   323	
   324	## Pre-Implementation Checklist
   325	
   326	Run this before finalizing any design:
   327	
   328	### Design Quality
   329	
   330	- [ ] Typography is distinctive (no Inter/Roboto/Arial)
   331	- [ ] Color palette has clear dominant + accent (not evenly distributed)
   332	- [ ] Background has atmosphere (not solid white/gray)
   333	- [ ] At least one memorable/unforgettable element
   334	- [ ] Animations are orchestrated (not scattered)
   335	
   336	### Mobile Responsiveness
   337	
   338	- [ ] Hero centers on mobile (no empty grid space)
   339	- [ ] All grids collapse to single column
   340	- [ ] Forms stack vertically
   341	- [ ] Large lists use accordion (not horizontal scroll)
   342	- [ ] Font sizes scale down appropriately
   343	
   344	### Form Consistency
   345	
   346	- [ ] Input, select, textarea all styled consistently
   347	- [ ] Radio/checkbox visible (check transparent-border styles)
   348	- [ ] Dropdown options have readable backgrounds
   349	- [ ] Labels use CSS variables (not hardcoded colors)
   350	
   351	### Accessibility
   352	
   353	- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI)
   354	- [ ] Focus states visible
   355	- [ ] Semantic HTML (nav, main, section, article)
   356	- [ ] Alt text for images
   357	- [ ] Keyboard navigation works
   358	
   359	---
   360	
   361	## shadcn/ui Components
   362	
   363	10 common components pre-installed (button, badge, card, accordion, dialog, navigation-menu, tabs, sheet, separator, avatar, alert). Add more with `npx shadcn@latest add [name]` or install all with `npx shadcn@latest add --all`.
   364	
   365	See **[references/shadcn-components.md](references/shadcn-components.md)** for full component reference.
   366	
   367	Most used for landing pages:
   368	
   369	- `Button`, `Badge` — CTAs and labels
   370	- `Card` — Feature cards, pricing tiers
   371	- `Accordion` — FAQ sections
   372	- `Dialog` — Modals, video players
   373	- `NavigationMenu` — Header nav
   374	- `Tabs` — Feature showcases
   375	- `Carousel` — Testimonials
   376	
   377	---
   378	
   379	## References
   380	
   381	- **[references/design-philosophy.md](references/design-philosophy.md)** — Extended anti-AI-slop guidance
   382	- **[references/mobile-patterns.md](references/mobile-patterns.md)** — Detailed responsive CSS
   383	- **[references/shadcn-components.md](references/shadcn-components.md)** — Component quick reference
   384	- **[templates/site-config.ts](templates/site-config.ts)** — Full siteConfig example
   385	
   386	---
   387	
   388	## Examples
   389	
   390	### Prompt → Output
   391	
   392	**Input**:
   393	
   394	> "Portfolio site for a photographer. Minimal, editorial feel. 
   395	> Grid gallery with lightbox, about section, contact form."
   396	
   397	**Design Decisions**:
   398	
   399	- Tone: Editorial/Magazine
   400	- Typography: Cormorant Garamond (display) + Inter... wait, banned. Plus Jakarta Sans (body)
   401	- Color: Near-black bg (#0c0c0c), warm white text (#f5f5f0), copper accent (#b87333)
   402	- Unforgettable: Full-bleed hero image with text overlay that reveals on scroll
   403	- Motion: Gallery images fade in staggered on scroll
   404	
   405	**Output**: Complete Next.js project with responsive gallery, lightbox component, and contact form with validation.

steps.message:
I've built the complete **WellStream Platform** 5-page marketing landing site and output all files to `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

## Pages Built

| Page | File | Key Sections |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Home** | `index.html` | Hero, Featured Product Banner, Use Cases Grid, Platform Overview Diagram (3 pillars), Industry Tabs (E&P/Midstream/Downstream/Utilities/Solar-Wind/Mining), Company Culture, Renewables CTA, Footer |
| **Platform Overview** | `platform-overview.html` | Hero, Platform Benefits (5 cards), Circular Stat Indicators (80/89%/31%), Implementation Timeline with progress bars, Accordion Features (5 expandable sections), Data Lifecycle Diagram (4-step flow), Testimonial Carousel with dot nav, CTA |
| **Security** | `security.html` | Hero, Security/SOC Compliance tabs, 5 security feature cards, compliance checklist, CTA |
| **Integration** | `integration.html` | Hero, ETL/APIs/Dashboards tabbed navigation, ETL benefits grid, API & Dashboard detail lists, CTA |
| **Request Demo** | `request-demo.html` | Demo form with validation (First Name, Last Name, Email, Company, Phone, Job Title, Country, Comments), success state, global support contact sidebar |

## Design & Technical Details

- **Dark professional theme**: Navy/charcoal backgrounds (`#0D1B2A`, `#1B2838`) with teal (`#00B4D8`) and green (`#6CC24A`) accents
- **Typography**: Space Grotesk (display) + Plus Jakarta Sans (body) — distinctive, non-generic choices per the skill guidelines
- **Atmosphere**: Gradient mesh backgrounds, subtle grain texture overlay, glassmorphism nav
- **Responsive**: Fully mobile-first with collapsible grids, stacked forms, and accordion nav
- **Interactions**: 
  - Cookie consent banner with Accept/Decline + localStorage persistence
  - Smooth tab switching across all tabbed interfaces
  - Accordion with single-open behavior
  - Testimonial carousel with dot navigation
  - Form validation with error states
- **Navigation**: Persistent header with Platform dropdown + "Request A Demo" CTA on all pages
- **No build step needed**: All pages are pre-built static HTML/JS/CSS files openable directly in a browser

All files are in `/app/output/` with `index.html` as the main entry point.
